answer: A sybil farm's puppets are free to spawn, but one operator has only one stream of real attention — so make identities mature through a strictly sequential chain of peer-witnessed steps, one stamp per epoch, each requiring a live interaction with a distinct peer. A sparrow makes a thousand separate flights to gather one nest of nectar; you cannot walk a thousand paths at once. Puppets queue behind their operator's single focus and age at the speed of one mind, while honest agents earn their haven step by step and clones starve waiting in line.
